title: Transformers | Overwatch 2 | THE LINE Studio
description: A trailer for the iconic collab commemorating the launch of four new legendary Transformers skins for Overwatch2

attrs.class: p6 module-team fw470 slash-light gutters case-hero-team__copy

children: Imagine our faces when we were told the next project we'd get to work on would be a Overwatch 2 x Transformers collab!

We wanted to give some flavour of the original show and pay homage to it in the way we approached the look and feel of the piece. We are beyond proud to have had the chance to make a small contribution to the gargantuan legacy of Transformers, and of course, Overwatch. That said, animating mechs is super frigging hard! It's really a specialised skill, so we’re super proud of the team for rising to the challenge.

attrs.class: p3 module-team fw470 slash-light gutters module-proxy

children: Transformers is probably most 80s kids introduction to mechs, It is the quintessential Sat morning cartoon and toy line. My earliest memories as a child is watching the transformers animated movie in the cinema at 8 years old with my mum. (I legit held back tears when Optimus prime died) That movie has inspired me in my career countless times, so getting the opportunity to direct this piece was a dream come true. I really wanted to pay homage to 1989 movie “what if the team at Toei Animation were making this film today? What would it look like?” That was my north star for the entire project. There’s “more to meets the eye” on this project as we used 3D assets to bring the characters to life while keeping 2d drawing sensibilities. It was exciting once again explore this technique and see how its evolved since our work MechaStorm - Heroes of the Storm. My first project with Blizzard.
